blurb: Fish the inshore waters of Ocean City, Maryland aboard Lucky Break Charters. We provide guided fishing trips for flounder, trout, croaker, bluefish, red drum, striped bass, tautog and other fish. For nature enthusiasts we offer 1 hour eco-tourism cruises in the late afternoon or evening. Our tours cover the back bay from Assateague Bridge to Ocean city Inlet.
